Veel MKB-bedrijven verliezen tijd en zic: Many SMEs lose time and visibility because mobile payment flows do not automatically and correctly enter the accounting; that slows cash management, increases manual work and raises compliance risk.
Mobiele betaaloplossingen (QR, wallets,: Mobile payment solutions (QR, wallets, in-app) generate transactions that are structured differently from traditional card/SEPA bookings.
Boekhoudsoftware en kassasystemen spreke: Accounting software and POS systems sometimes use different standards; there is no standardized data flow or connector.
Mensen en processen zijn niet ingericht: People and processes are not set up for fast reconciliation of new payment types; responsibilities and controls are missing.
